# p10k-rs v0.1.9 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner
> and tag when ready. The release workflow fires on
> `git push origin v0.1.9`.

**The "CI hygiene & forward-compat" release.** Three small,
additive CI changes plus one README polish. No `src/` code
changed; test count holds at 603.

**Test count:** 603 passing, 3 ignored (same as v0.1.8).
**Slice count:** 1 code commit, no functional change.
**Theme:** "CI as documentation."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### Docs site now publishes via `gh-pages` branch

The v0.1.8 docs deploy failed because the workflow used
`actions/upload-pages-artifact` + `actions/deploy-pages`, which
require Pages source set to "GitHub Actions" — a separate
settings option from the more common "Deploy from a branch" UI.
The workflow now pushes the built mdBook output to a
`gh-pages` branch via `peaceiris/actions-gh-pages`.

To enable the site, set your repo's Pages settings to:

```
Source: Deploy from a branch
Branch:  gh-pages
Folder:  / (root)
```

The `gh-pages` branch is created on first successful run with
`force_orphan: true`, so it stays a single-commit history
instead of accumulating weight over time.

### `cargo deny` runs on every CI push

A new `deny` job in `ci.yml` runs
`cargo deny check --workspace --locked` per push and per PR.
Catches new RUSTSEC advisories, accidental license drift, and
banned-crate slip-ins at PR time rather than as a hand-run
pre-tag check. The action is sha-pinned alongside everything
else in the workflows.

If you have your own fork and want to opt out, delete the
`deny` job from `ci.yml`.

### README link table includes `daemon-health`

v0.1.8 shipped the `p10k-rs daemon-health` subcommand plus a
full mdBook reference page at `docs/src/reference/daemon-health.md`,
but the reference was only discoverable via the CHANGELOG.
The README's "Where to go next" table now points at it
directly.

### `docs.yml` opts into Node.js 24 ahead of the runner default

The `peaceiris/actions-mdbook` and `peaceiris/actions-gh-pages`
actions still ship as Node.js 20 actions, which the GitHub
runner deprecates on 2026-09-16. Set
`FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: "true"` at the workflow
env level so the docs job runs on Node 24 ahead of the default
flip. Drop the env block once both actions ship Node-24-native
major versions.

## Security posture (no surface changes)

- **`cargo deny` is now a CI gate, not an honour check.**
  Past releases (v0.1.8 in particular) reasoned about supply
  chain by hand-running `cargo deny check` before the tag.
  That ran cleanly but was easy to skip. The CI gate
  forecloses that.
- **No new dependencies.** `Cargo.lock` diff vs v0.1.8 is the
  workspace version bump only.
- **No `unsafe` added.**

## Slice ledger

See [`CHANGELOG.md`](../../CHANGELOG.md) for the full
breakdown. v0.1.9 is one logical surface (`ci: hygiene`)
delivered as a single commit on top of v0.1.8.

## Upgrading

```sh
git pull
./install.sh
```

No config-file migration. If you maintain a fork and adopted
the v0.1.8 docs workflow, switch the workflow + the Pages
settings together (see "Docs site now publishes via gh-pages
branch" above).
